metadata.name: loop-design-check
metadata.description: Design a goal-oriented agent loop or review one for failure modes: spinning, Goodhart-gaming the verifier, or running a wrong answer to completion. Covers machine-decidable goals, loop types, plan/build/judge skeletons, and runaway prevention; mechanism wiring lives in autonomous-loops. Use when designing, writing, or checking an agent loop. Trigger concepts: writing and designing loops, checking loop correctness, loop health checks, runaway prevention, machine-decidable goals, five failure modes, and plan/build/judge.
